# `hk util destroyed-symlinks`

- **Usage:** `hk util destroyed-symlinks [FILES]…`
- **Effect:** read-only

Check for symlinks replaced by regular files containing their target path

## Arguments

- **`[FILES]…`** — Files to check. Defaults to the whole repository.

## Flags

- **`-h --help`** — Print help

<!-- hk documentation examples -->

## Examples

Check the whole repository, or narrow the check to specific paths.

```sh
hk util destroyed-symlinks
hk util destroyed-symlinks docs/link.md
```
